description: A shell script used for testing rename detection in diff engine, involving setup of files, performing git operations, and validating rename detection output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specified commands.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares the actual diff patch output to an expected output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within the test output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Creates a file with specified lines for testing.
